## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` passes (lint, formatting, types, unit tests, build)
- [ ] `npm run test:e2e` passes, or the change doesn't touch the UI
- [ ] New behaviour has tests; a new format passes the contract tests in `tests/codecs.test.js`
- [ ] Docs updated if needed (README, CHANGELOG under "Unreleased")
- [ ] Checked with the keyboard alone, and in both light and dark themes, if the UI changed
